tests.test: Opening: WebGL, named Ink scene, inspector closed, oversized O/I
Inspector navigation does not reset or advance paused simulation
Click-to-pin is one-shot, preserves formation identities and palette
Pin is placed at the requested canvas coordinate
Dragging a pin preserves depth and edits only its position
One undo restores the entire drag
Repeller changes the selected influence, not palette or stations
3D pin honours the visible working-plane depth
A new formation is independently placed without replacing existing entities
Glyph typing does not activate the Pin shortcut
Empty glyph draft commits a sensible fallback
Sequence spatial keyframe is a local offset, not an entity replacement
Keyframe placement projects back to its actual click
Automation is created from its parameter in the correct context
Evaluating an automation never overwrites the base value
Optional editorial text is actual scene content and can be hidden
Text is safely rendered literally rather than interpreted as HTML
Scene framing is stored and restored deliberately
Duplicate scene makes a separately named full state
Undo duplicate restores the scene list
Physical cymatics are disabled instead of represented as fake templates
Journey file preserves text, entities, scenes and automation
Living HTML artifact opens with its complete embedded journey and presentation view
PNG capture is a real image at the requested output size
Transparent PNG contains real alpha, not a paper-coloured rectangle
Video recording reaches a real reviewable media element
Browser encoder produces a decodable video file
Autosave persists the authoring document through the storage interface
Seven-centre preset exposes seven editable entities with independent station links
Interact tool activates only the transient pointer
Switching to Pin clears transient pointer influence
Repeated pinning is explicit and places distinct force centres
Mobile opening has no horizontal page overflow
Mobile contextual editor remains within viewport
Journey playback advances full named scenes on the shared clock
All exercised browser interactions complete without runtime errors
Reduced motion starts paused without prohibiting deliberate play
Reduced-motion user can explicitly resume

environment: Chromium + software WebGL under Xvfb; inline local content; explicit in-memory storage test double
